display.purpose: The one page title: her name on home, the page name on inner pages. Archivo 800 at 75% width (--size-display).

headline.purpose: Section headings, case-study title, case metric and the Contact email address (--size-section).

title.purpose: Role names, card titles, subsection labels, button labels. Body size at 700 weight; not a separate size.

body.purpose: All reading text (--size-body); leads in plum mist up to 40rem, resume text capped at 65ch.

label.purpose: Dates, locations, card meta, tags, footer, slot captions; tabular figures, sentence case (--size-meta).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for button fills, nav colour and card media scale.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Button, nav and icon-button state changes.

motion.name: media-scale
motion.purpose: Work card media grows slightly on hover or focus while its muted clip plays.

motion.name: name-tighten
motion.purpose: Hero name tightens as the page scrolls; static fallback and off under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid bone-white button for the single main action on a page.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.5rem; font-family: var(--font, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size: var(--size-body, 1.0625rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--text, #f4f3ef); border-radius: 0; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-button--primary { background: var(--text, #f4f3ef); color: var(--bg, #2a1336); } .ds-button--primary:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #f4f3ef); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Bone-white outline for the secondary action; fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 1.5rem; font-family: var(--font, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size: var(--size-body, 1.0625rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--text, #f4f3ef); border-radius: 0; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--text, #f4f3ef); color: var(--bg, #2a1336); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #f4f3ef); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 48px square reel control with an inline SVG chevron.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Next work"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14)); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, opacity 0.2s; } .ds-icon-button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); } .ds-icon-button:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #f4f3ef); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Sticky translucent header: name left, plum-mist links right, current page bone-white and underlined.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; min-height: 4rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: rgb(42 19 54 / 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); font-family: var(--font, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size: var(--size-body, 1.0625rem); color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); } .ds-brand { font-weight: 700; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-nav-links a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #c9b3d6); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-links a:hover, .ds-nav-links a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); } .ds-nav-links a[aria-current="page"] { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.5em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #f4f3ef); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Signature reel and portfolio item: 9:16 square media, bold title, plum-mist meta, no container. Media scales on hover; clips play muted.
components.html: Street interviews2026
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; width: 15rem; color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size: var(--size-body, 1.0625rem); } .ds-card-media { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 9 / 16; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface, #3a1f48); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #5a3f6a, #3a1f48); transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-fill, .ds-card:focus-visible .ds-card-fill { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-card-play { position: absolute; left: 0.75rem; bottom: 0.75rem; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; background: rgb(42 19 54 / 0.75); color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); transition: opacity 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-play, .ds-card:focus-visible .ds-card-play { opacity: 0; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: var(--size-meta, 0.875rem); color: var(--muted, #c9b3d6); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #f4f3ef); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-facts { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 42rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14)); font-family: var(--font, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size: var(--size-body, 1.0625rem); color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); } .ds-facts li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.25rem 1.5rem; padding-block: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14)); } .ds-when { color: var(--muted, #c9b3d6); font-size: var(--size-meta, 0.875rem); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: Condensed 800-weight section heading on a 1px bone-white rule, as used on the resume.
components.css: .ds-section { margin: 0; padding-bottom: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--text, #f4f3ef); font-family: var(--font, Archivo, sans-serif); font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 75%; font-size: var(--size-section, clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.5rem)); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--text, #f4f3ef); }

components.name: Empty Media Slot (preview-only)
components.description: Dashed placeholder frame rendered only with PREVIEW_SLOTS=1 to show where media goes; never shipped in production.
components.css: .ds-slot { width: 15rem; aspect-ratio: 9 / 16; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--surface, #3a1f48); border: 1px dashed rgb(255 255 255 / 0.32); } .ds-slot-label { font-family: var(--font, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size: var(--size-meta, 0.875rem); line-height: 1.4; color: var(--muted, #c9b3d6); text-align: center; padding: 1rem; }

narrative.overview:
The house lights are dimmed to a deep plum and the screen is the brightest thing in the room. One plum ground, off-white type and no interface accent colour mean that, beyond the plum, every hue on the page comes from her clips and stills. Media sits in tall vertical frames, the way her work plays on a phone, and the page is built to be watched first and read second: a large name, one plain line, two actions, then a horizontal reel of work.

One family carries everything. Archivo at 800 weight and 75% width makes the condensed, poster-like display voice; the same family at normal width carries all reading text. Only four type sizes exist on screen. Structure comes from hairline rules, generous section spacing and square-cornered media, never from boxes, tints or decoration. Density is low on the home page and calm on the resume, where a date column and hairline-ruled entries make a recruiter's skim fast.

Confirmed rejections: the earlier cobalt-and-chartreuse build, judged "messy" by the owner; a near-black ground, judged "too dark" (the owner chose plum from five rendered grounds on 2026-10-07); too many fonts and sizes; repeated content on one page.
keyCharacteristics: Deep plum ground, off-white type, zero UI accent colour; the work supplies every other colour.
One family (Archivo variable), two widths, four sizes.
9:16 media with square corners, shown in place and playing on hover or focus.
Hairline rules and spacing for structure; no cards, shadows or rounded corners.
Two button states only: solid bone-white and bone-white outline.

rules.name: The Work Brings The Colour Rule
rules.body: Plum is the ground, not an accent. Links, focus, buttons and highlights are all bone-white on plum ground; there is no second UI hue. A colour on screen that is neither the plum family nor her media is a defect.

rules.name: The Four Sizes Rule
rules.body: The screen uses exactly four type sizes: display, section, body and meta (the `--size-*` tokens). Every new element maps onto one of them; emphasis comes from weight (400, 700, 800) or colour (bone-white versus plum mist), never from a fifth size. Print stylesheet sizes (28pt display, 10.5pt body) are a separate medium and do not count.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo is the only typeface. The condensed 75% width belongs to display and headline roles only; everything else is normal width.

rules.name: The Say It Once Rule
rules.body: Each fact appears once per page: one email, one set of social links, one listing of a role. The header carries no contact button, the footer carries only "Back to top", and the home About block lists current roles and school as one-line facts with a link to the full resume rather than restating it.

rules.name: The Lights-Down Rule
rules.body: Nothing is lifted. If an element needs separation, use a hairline or spacing, not a shadow or a lighter panel.

dos: Do keep the UI to the plum family (ground, surface, mist), bone white and hairline, so her media is the only other source of colour.
Do map every text element onto one of the four sizes (display, section, body, meta) and vary weight or colour for emphasis.
Do use Archivo 800 at 75% width only for the page title, section headings and the rare headline-size data point.
Do frame media in 9:16 with square corners on plum surface, playing muted in place.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines and the section spacing token.
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more and the 2px bone-white focus ring offset 4px.
Do omit a section when its data is absent, rather than filling it with placeholders in production.
donts: Don't add an accent colour, gradient, tinted panel or highlight, or a second hue beside plum.
Don't introduce a fifth type size or a second typeface.
Don't show the same email, link set or role twice on one page.
Don't add eyebrows or kickers above headings, uppercase tracked labels, or decorative frames around media.
Don't round corners, add shadows, or wrap text in cards.
Don't ship the dashed empty-slot frame outside `PREVIEW_SLOTS` mode.
